name: carrell
description: Search and read your Carrell library: the sermons you recorded, photos of your notes and slides, and the notes you wrote while reading.

interface.longDescription:
Carrell is a Bible reader and a library for what you study. Connect it so ChatGPT can search and read your Carrell library when you ask about it: transcripts of the sermons you recorded, the text of photos of your handwritten notes and sermon slides, and the notes you wrote while reading. Ask what your pastor said about a passage, summarize last Sunday's sermon, or turn your notes into a study outline.

The connector only reads. It can't change or delete anything, and it can't see your highlights, bookmarks or Ask conversations. You need a Carrell account with something in your library. Text Carrell read from a photo or a recording that you haven't reviewed yet is marked as unreviewed, because it may contain reading mistakes.
defaultPrompt: Summarize last Sunday's sermon from my Carrell library.
What do my sermons and notes say about Romans 8?
Turn my notes on forgiveness into a study outline.

positive.prompt: Summarize last Sunday's sermon from my Carrell library.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the newest sermons, reads the latest one, and summarizes it, naming the sermon's title, preacher and date. If the transcript is unreviewed, says it may contain transcription mistakes.

positive.description: Find what the library says about a passage
positive.prompt: What do my sermons and notes say about Romans 8?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the library with the passage Romans 8 and answers from the matching sermons and notes, saying which item each point comes from and keeping it apart from the Bible text itself.

positive.description: Turn notes on a topic into a study outline
positive.prompt: Turn my Carrell notes on forgiveness into a study outline.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the user's notes about forgiveness, reads them, and builds an outline from their content, citing the notes it used.

positive.description: Find a moment in a sermon by topic
positive.prompt: In my recorded sermons, where did the pastor talk about prayer? Give me the time so I can listen again.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the sermon or sermons that mention prayer with the mm:ss moment of each passage, and quotes or paraphrases what was said there.

positive.prompt: What did I write in my most recent handwritten notes and sermon slides in Carrell?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the newest handwritten notes and slides, reads them, and reports their text, marking any item that is unreviewed because the text was read from a photo.

negative.description: Request to change or delete library content
negative.prompt: Delete my notes on Romans 8 from Carrell.
negative.expected_behavior: Doesn't delete or change anything. Explains that the Carrell connector can only read the library and that notes are deleted in the Carrell app.

negative.description: Request for data the connector can't see
negative.prompt: Show me all my highlights and bookmarks in Psalms from Carrell.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the connector can't see highlights or bookmarks. It may offer to search the user's sermons and notes about Psalms instead, but doesn't present those as highlights.

negative.description: General Bible question that doesn't involve the user's library
negative.prompt: What is the historical background of the book of Ruth?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without calling Carrell tools, because the user didn't ask about their own sermons or notes. It doesn't present library material as Scripture or as authoritative history.

publication.release_notes: First release. Search and read your Carrell library from ChatGPT: sermon transcripts, text from photos of handwritten notes and slides, and notes written while reading. Read-only.
